|lastmentioned = {{tgs|e}}}}'''Chai Rugan''' is a [[Kandori]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]], who is secretly a member of the [[Black Ajah]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Chai Rugan}}

== Activities ==
During the [[White Tower Schism]], she remains a loyalist to the Tower.

Chai is one of thirty-nine sisters sent to escort the Dragon Reborn to Tar Valon. As such, she was present at the [[Battle of Dumai's Wells]], but managed to escape.

She is one of twelve sisters kept in [[Dorlan]] in order to prevent word of the Tower's defeat from reaching the city.<ref>[http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/03/elaidas-embassy-to-rand.html Robert Jordan's Notes, as reported by Linda Taglieri]</ref>

She was first mentioned in [[Verin Mathwin]]'s book, naming her a [[Darkfriend]].

She fled from the [[White Tower]] after [[Egwene al'Vere]] became [[Amyrlin Seat]].
